email.subject: Temperature alarm at receipt - RB-NL-7712 / AWB 583-1190 2264
email.body:
Dear Joris,

shipment RB-NL-7712 arrived today (11 Nov 2026). The ColdTrace logger shows a major alarm on 9 Nov 2026: maximum 15.0 °C and almost 4 hours above 8 °C. All 6 pieces are quarantined pending your QA disposition. Logger file attached.

Regards,
Priya Raman
Quality Lead, Hudson Clinical Supply

email.subject: Excursion RB-NL-7712 - WMS records requested
email.body:
Dear Sanne,

the logger of RB-NL-7712 shows 15.0 °C at your Schiphol hub timeframe on 9 Nov 2026. Please send the hub movement log under clause 5.3 within two business days, and explain why no excursion report was received under clause 5.2.

Regards,
Joris van Dam
Logistics Manager, Rheinfeld Biologics B.V.

email.subject: RE: Excursion RB-NL-7712 - WMS records requested
email.body:
Dear Joris,

please find attached the WMS extract. Due to peak volumes the shipment was staged on inbound floor F3 for approx. 4 hours before a cold-room slot became available in CR-02. We regret this and are investigating internally.

Kind regards,
Sanne de Wit
Operations Manager, Polder Freight Solutions

Elena

temperature_duty.title: Temperature Range
temperature_duty.quote: Temperature Range. The Forwarder shall keep the Goods within the Temperature Range at all times while they are in its Custody, using qualified and validated equipment.

hub_storage.title: Hub storage
hub_storage.quote: Hub storage. At all Forwarder hubs and warehouses the Goods shall be stored exclusively in qualified cold rooms maintained at +2 °C to +8 °C. The Goods shall not be staged in ambient areas, on docks or on warehouse floors for longer than 30 minutes in aggregate per hub.

air_carriers.title: Air carriers
air_carriers.quote: Air carriers. In respect of carriage by air performed by an air carrier, the Forwarder's liability shall not exceed the amount the Forwarder is able to recover from that air carrier under the Montreal Convention 1999 or other applicable air law. On request, the Forwarder shall assign to the Customer its rights of action against the air carrier.

excursion_reporting.title: Excursion reporting
excursion_reporting.quote: Excursion reporting. The Forwarder shall notify the Customer in writing of any known or suspected Temperature Excursion within 12 hours of becoming aware of it.

liability_basis.title: Basis
liability_basis.quote: Basis. The Forwarder is liable for loss of or damage to the Goods, including damage resulting from a Temperature Excursion, occurring while the Goods are in its Custody, unless it proves that the loss arose from circumstances it could not avoid and whose consequences it could not prevent.

liability_cap.quote: Limit of liability. For loss or damage resulting from a breach of clause 3 (Temperature control and service levels), the Forwarder's liability shall be limited to the invoice value of the affected Goods, as evidenced by the Customer's commercial invoice.

damaged_goods.quote: Damaged goods. Goods that the Customer's Quality Assurance rejects as a result of a Temperature Excursion are deemed damaged. The Customer's documented QA decision is conclusive in the absence of manifest error.

notice.title: Notice of claim
notice.quote: Notice of claim. The Customer shall give written notice of any claim, or of circumstances that may give rise to a claim, within 7 days of Delivery. Such notice may reserve the Customer's rights pending its quality assessment and need not state the final amount claimed.

time_bar.title: Time bar
time_bar.quote: Time bar. Any claim is barred unless legal proceedings are commenced within one year of Delivery.

exclusions.title: Excluded causes
exclusions.quote: Excluded causes. settlement.title: Measure of indemnity
